name: Cumberland University
tuition_note: 2025-26 tuition & fees ($27,240 tuition + $1,300 general access fee, both full-time annual) from official Cumberland catalog (cumberland.smartcatalogiq.com 2025-2026 tuition-and-fees page); private school single rate applies to all students. Housing = room only, standard double occupancy (Edward/Justin Potter) $2,334/semester = $4,668/year; other halls range $5,832-$7,000/year. Mandatory meal plan (board) is $6,192/year, listed separately. cumberland.edu pages returned HTTP 403; IPEDS 219949 NCES shows 2024-25 tuition&fees $27,840 and combined food+housing $12,800 as corroboration.
